name: Stack
description: A wrapper that lays out its children in a vertical column with one consistent gap between them. Use it to space a group of blocks instead of adding margins or empty spacer elements.
summary: Vertical flow of blocks with a consistent gap
researchNote: Vertical flow with a consistent gap

elements.name: Children
elements.description: Any blocks, laid out top to bottom in source order

elements.name: Gap
elements.description: One value from the spacing scale, applied only between children

elements.name: Separators
elements.description: A Separator line between each pair of children

configOptions.options: None, Extra small, Small, Medium, Large, Extra large
<div>, <ul> or <ol> for a list of like items

variants.caption: Centered — children aligned to the center
Nested — a tight stack inside a loose one

usageNotes: Stack only sets spacing and adds no meaning. Render a <div>, or a <ul> or <ol> when the children are a list of like items.
Build it with flexbox or grid and gap, so space appears only between children and never before the first or after the last.
Section and Slot already have a stack gap setting. Add a separate Stack only for a group that needs a tighter or looser gap, such as a heading with its intro text.
Take gap values from the spacing scale rather than one-off sizes, so spacing stays consistent across the page.
For side-by-side columns, use Grid. For a row of related actions, use Button group.
